prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE. Sleek, spacious contemporary executive office of a design company, in warm walnut, white and grey. A large walnut desk is covered with architectural plans, wood samples, a metal figurine and a pour-over coffee station. Behind it stands a black leather executive chair. To one side are a lounge area of black leather sofas and armchairs around a white marble coffee table, and a wall sign reading 'JUST DO IT'. The door is on the side wall facing the desk, with open space in front of the desk for standing visitors. Floor-to-ceiling windows behind the desk let in bright, soft daylight from behind and to the left of the desk. Warm recessed ceiling spots and a brass desk lamp fill in from above. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
